caption: The drawing is a technical, architectural-style illustration of a cabinet, rendered in black ink lines on a beige or sepia-toned background. The image is divided into two main sections: a front view on the left and a side profile on the right. The cabinet has a symmetrical structure with a prominent cornice at the top, beneath which there is a decorative rectangular panel with a central floral medallion and radiating lines. Below this are two horizontally-aligned drawers, each with a knob, and underneath these is a pair of paneled cabinet doors, each also fitted with a knob. The bottom part of the cabinet is supported by small round feet. The right side of the drawing shows a detailed side view, illustrating the depth and profile of the cornice, the thickness and detailing of the drawer area, and the shape of the cabinet's curved legs, with multiple labeled dimensions. Numerous dimensional annotations in inches are placed around the drawing, specifying measurements for width, height, depth, and spacing between features. A note to the right attributes the design to Curtis, Strich & Zeidler Piano Company, with additional text stating "Lorenz Rothkranz #246228" and the scale "¼" to 1'."
title: Upright Piano
